description: Stores an image on Hollerpost for use in an email and returns its https URL. Pass url (a public https image, for example from the business website) or data_base64 (the file itself). For a picture the person has on their device or dropped into the chat, use email_image_upload_link instead. JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF, up to 5 MB (GIFs up to 2 MB). Hollerpost shrinks it to at most 1200px wide and saves it as JPEG, or PNG when it has transparency, so the returned type can differ from the upload. Emails link to the image rather than attaching it, so it adds nothing to the message size. Limits: 100 uploads per API key per 24 hours and 500 per workspace per 30 days, so upload each picture once and reuse its url. Use the returned url in image_url, a section image_url, or an image line in body_md: ![What it shows](url). Sends nothing. Requires API key scope: draft.

data_base64.description: The image file, base64 encoded (a data: URL prefix is fine).

url.description: Public https URL of the image to copy.
